faq: What if x or y exceed the zoom's grid?
At zoom z, x and y run 0 … 2^z − 1. Out-of-range inputs are rejected, not wrapped — a tile address outside the grid is a bug report, not a tile.
Quadkeys are defined on the unflipped XYZ grid. If your stack flips y, un-flip before encoding (y = 2^z − 1 − y_tms) or the key belongs to the mirrored tile.
